data_fields.name: flee_distance
data_fields.donor_constant: current distance to target plus template FleeDistance (default not read)

data_fields.name: chase_query_range
data_fields.donor_constant: unit vision range (chase looks out to full vision)

data_fields.name: preference_rank_count
data_fields.donor_constant: index in PreferredClasses list, rank 0 attacked at once

best_idea: A unit's aggression is a named stance row of booleans (who to target, whether to chase, how far to leash), and it picks its target by a ranked class list, taking a rank-0 match at once.
decision_why: Take the stance rows as enemy profile data and the ranked class list as the many-on-one target rule; replace the 1000 ms wall-time chase check with a server-tick count and add MAX_ATTACKERS = 3 as a separate engine gate, which the donor does not have.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a defensive foe with hold radius 6 attacks a player who steps within 6 tiles and ignores one at 7 tiles, and that a violent foe keeps chasing a player until the player is out of its vision at one check.
